title: How to Align Dates on Your Resume | The BEST Format
description:
There are a lot of questions about how to align dates on your resume: Should you group them by position or by company? Should you include months AND years? Should dates go on the left or on the right? Should you use numbers or letters for resume dates? What if you were at a company for less than a year? Or what if you got promoted to another role at the same company? 

In this video, we'll break down everything you need to know about dates on your resume: 

00:00 Introduction
00:23 How should you group resume dates?
01:09 Should you include months or just years?
01:43 Dates on the right vs. left 
02:02 How to adjust your date format quickly using the Teal Resume Builder
03:13 When to list dates by position vs. company
03:51 How to format dates by tenure at a company 
05:10 How to show promotions at the same company
05:52 Deep dive: Dates on the left vs. right
06:34 Date format (numbers or words?)
07:19 Takeaways & resume recommendations
08:30 Outro
